headline: Murder suspect escapes during police operation in Narsingdi
summary: Conflicting reports emerge as a man wanted in multiple criminal cases allegedly flees from police in Raipura upazila.
details: A man named Selim Mia, 45, wanted in multiple criminal cases including murder, allegedly escaped from police custody in Narsingdi’s Raipura upazila on Wednesday afternoon.

headline: Sylhet court sentences 2 to death for raping teenage girl
summary: The verdict comes after a legal battle over the assault on a minor, marking a severe penalty for the crime.
details: A court in Sylhet has sentenced two individuals to death for the rape of a teenage girl.
The verdict was delivered following a legal process to address the crime against the minor.
The court's decision reflects the severity of the crime and the pursuit of justice for the victim.
The two convicts were found guilty of the assault on the teenage girl.
